q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of a urine collection bag?
title: Urine bag carbon footprint per bag
short: Weigh the PVC or PE film, tubing, connector and valve per bag and multiply by supplier figures. Add welding, assembly and sterilisation energy, then divide the plant's energy by bags made.

ul: Sterilisation, often by ethylene oxide, and packing.

p: Report per bag by capacity and type.

example.title: Worked example: plant energy per bag (one month)
lines: Plant total: 21,300 / 500,000 = 0.0426 kg CO2 per bag
Add film, tubing and valve for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
